snippet.title: Beyond service Cinematic Gameplay 001 HD
snippet.description:
🌍 Beyond Service—one year in the making! 🌍

After a year of passion, challenges, and breakthroughs, our indie team at Goondu Interactive is thrilled to unveil the gameplay cinematic trailer for Beyond Service! This game is more than just an adventure; it's our heart and soul, a journey of resilience, and a testament to every hour spent refining every detail. From sketch to screen, we've poured everything into creating an immersive experience set against a rich, uniquely Nigerian story backdrop.

Thank you to everyone who has supported us along the way! Whether you've offered guidance, cheered us on, or believed in our vision, we couldn’t have made it this far without you.

Join us on this journey—because this is only the beginning. Check out our new trailer and share the excitement as we get closer to the release!

#BeyondService #GameDev #IndieGame #CinematicTrailer #GoonduInteractive
